stemMd: Two geometrically similar solid models have corresponding lengths in the ratio 2:5. What is the ratio of their volumes?
explanationMd: Volume scales with the cube of every linear scale factor. Cubing both parts of 2:5 gives 8:125; area would instead use the square.

distractorRationale.c: This does not follow the geometric scale.
distractorRationale.e: Multiplying both terms by three does not cube the scale.
